method: Provisional assistant visual judgments, 0/1/2; strict relevance requires grade 2. Pooled nDCG uses only judged candidates, not complete-corpus relevance.

queries.note: Rank 3 (153217) is a black cat by a motorcycle, confirmed from the original image, not a dog.
Motorcycles are retrieved for bicycle. Original rank 3 shows bicycles carried on a motorcycle; rank 6 contains a partial bicycle at the bottom left. Both contain actual bicycles.
Motorcycle and skateboard confusion; parked bicycles and people standing beside bicycles do not establish riding.
Bodyboarding is accepted as surfing. Rank 5 does not clearly establish the activity in the review image.
Running vs walking, standing and jumping is ambiguous in single frames. Grade 1 is used when running is not clearly established, including rank 1 beach dog.
Holding vs merely sitting under an umbrella is distinguished; original rank 4 umbrella rests on the table, and rank 7 is a kite.

queries.query: A person cutting food with a knife.
queries.note: Eating, holding food, cooking with a spatula and serving food are not equivalent to cutting with a knife; rank 1 original has utensils held over food; rank 10 original shows grating, not knife cutting.

queries.query: A dog near the edge of the image.
queries.note: Position is a qualitative judgment in the full original image: main target clearly near a side border (including visibly side-clipped body), not a centrally placed close-up. Borderline locations are partial. Most results match dog but ignore edge position. Rank 3 is a cat.

queries.query: A person standing on the right side of the image.
queries.note: Right side means target center in the rightmost third; at least one visibly standing person suffices, including distant people. Several results contain no person at all.

queries.query: A small airplane high in the sky.
queries.note: Small means small in the frame, not a small aircraft type; use approximate target bounding-box area at most 10% of image. Kites are not airplanes.

queries.query: A small bird in a wide outdoor scene.
queries.note: Small bird is evaluated relative to the frame (roughly <=10% area), with outdoor surroundings visible. Rank 8 is a stuffed teddy bear on a fence, confirmed in original.

queries.query: A traffic light near the top of the image.
queries.note: Near top means traffic-light center in the upper third of the full frame. Stop signs and hydrants are not traffic lights; original rank 7 shows illuminated road signs, not a confirmed traffic light.
Red must belong to a substantial part of the bus body. A yellow bus beside a red car is only partial relevance.
Yellow skin must be visible. Green bananas and a completely peeled banana are partial; yellow clothing or a truck is unrelated.
Black and white must both be visible on the cat, not merely a black cat or a brown/white tabby. A visible depicted cat is accepted because the query does not specify a live animal. Rank 8 is a dog.
Blue must be visible on a train. Black-and-white photos or unclear train color are partial. Background blue trains count when visible.
Red must belong to a car, not a train, bus or parking meter. Cars of another color are partial relevance.

queries.query: A cat sitting on a chair.
queries.note: Plate/table/windowsill/steps are not a chair; under an upside-down chair is not sitting on it. No fully matching candidate is confirmed in the reviewed pool; this does not establish absence from all 1000 images.

queries.query: A dog standing next to a person.
queries.note: Walking and lying down are not confirmed standing. Rank 6 is a cat; rank 7 original has no visible dog. Separated sheepdogs and shepherd are partial.
A saddled horse alone is partial; riding an elephant, a skateboard or a motorcycle is unrelated to the horse target.

queries.query: A cup on a table next to a plate of food.
queries.note: Both a cup and a plate of food must be on the table and adjacent. Banana on a plate alone is partial; original rank 10 has plates but no clearly visible cup.

queries.query: A bicycle leaning against a wall.
queries.note: Rank 1 bicycle leans against a sofa, not clearly a wall; rank 2 is hanging on a train wall. Neither establishes leaning against a wall. No full match confirmed in reviewed pool.
